name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
statement: Overall demand environment remained mixed with consumption centered around festive and wedding-related shopping
quote: Looking back at the quarter, the overall demand environment remained mixed with consumption largely centered around festive and wedding-related shopping.
speaker: mgmt

name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
statement: Added net 5.5 lakh sq ft over last 12 months; 50 new stores and 2.5 lakh sq ft added in Q3
quote: We have also continued to invest in network expansion through growth capex, adding a net 5.5 lakh square feet of area over the last 12 months. This positions us well for future growth and operating leverage as these stores mature.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote mentions 5.5 lakh sq ft over 12 months, but not the Q3 additions.

name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
statement: OWND! plans 40-50 store openings in coming year
quote: So from a store opening standpoint, we would be looking at opening about 40 to 50 stores in the coming year.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote supports 40-50 stores in the coming year.

name: Aditya Birla Fashion and Retail Ltd
statement: Pantaloons average selling price increased 2-3% due to premiumization shift
quote: Also with non-apparel being integrated into our apparel strategy, we hope to see an ongoing improvement in our basket sizes as well. So not a very significant impact in terms of the basket size. But in terms of our average selling price, we've seen about a 2% to 3% increase because of the shift and because of our premiumization.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote states 2% to 3% ASP increase due to premiumization.

name: Premier Explosives Ltd
statement: RDX/HMX global demand strong, multiple inquiries, holding orders due to capacity expansion
quote: Yes. Even today, the demand remains same. There is no reduction in demand. We have several multiple queries and then because our project major expansion is going on, so we are holding the orders.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms strong demand, multiple queries, and holding orders for expansion.

name: Premier Explosives Ltd
statement: FY26 revenue guidance INR500-600 crore, EBITDA margin 15-20%
quote: Overall, at the end of the year, we are targeting or like we mentioned earlier, it will be in the range of -- revenue will be INR500 crores to INR600 crores. We'll be in that range. And profitability also, we expect to maintain total between 15% to 20%.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms revenue and EBITDA margin guidance.

name: Premier Explosives Ltd
statement: Defense receivables delayed 4-5 months, payment cycle 30 days after inspection clearance, pre-inspection wait 2-3 months
quote: Actually, defense is supposed to pay in 30 days. If they delay it by 5 months, what can we do? T. V. Chowdary: 30 days will start after everything is cleared, inspections are done, everything. But 30 days can always become 60 days. But before the 30 days period starts, there will be another 2, 3 months once you pack the product and waiting for inspections and dispatches
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote discusses delays and 30/60 days, but pre-inspection timing is not fully quantified as stated.

name: Premier Explosives Ltd
statement: FY26-27 capex ~INR50 crore funded by bank term loans and internal accruals
quote: The capex we plan for the financial year '26, '27 will be in the range of around INR50 crores.And how do we finance it? Vijay Kumar: That we are doing it from the bank. Term loans, we are taking it
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote and subsequent context confirm capex and bank term loan funding.

name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
statement: TAN plant expected to break even quickly; full capacity utilization hoped for by second half of FY27
quote: I would suggest, I would rather be quite optimistic and think that yes, we should be able to start breaking even quickly enough. I wouldn't hazard a guess how many quarters, but we should be able to break even quickly enough.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote says break even quickly, but H2 FY27 full capacity comes from adjacent context.

name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
statement: DAP subsidy now fixed MRP floating subsidy regime: basic NBS + Rs. 3,500 special package + advantage-disadvantage clause reimbursing difference beyond threshold
quote: There is a basic NBS price. On top of that, there is some special package of Rs. 3,500. And then there is an advantage- disadvantage clause, which means that if you have purchased beyond a number, then the difference between that number and your bill of lading price is then reimbursed separately.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms Rs. 3,500 special package and mechanics.

name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
statement: Gadepan-2 turnaround scheduled by February; Gadepan-1 and 3 to make up lost volumes; annual impact minor ~7,000-8,000 tons negative
quote: So, broadly, yes, it will be a minor, say, 7000-8,000 tons, negative kind of number.
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote gives 7000-8000 tons negative, but February turnaround timing is in earlier context.

name: Chambal Fertilisers & Chemicals Ltd
statement: Digital Farmer Connect app launched 2 months ago; 80,000-90,000 followers/subscribers; target 3-5 lakh by next year; no direct sales, used for education and referral
quote: This app was launched, I would say, about two months back and we have something like 80,000 to 90,000 followers and subscribers. So, we do dissem inate through LinkedIn, Meta and YouTube and so
speaker: mgmt
note: Quote confirms app launch timeline and 80,000-90,000 subscribers.
